versions.label: Latest development build — Damage, death, and restart
changes: House Cat and Rats now have health and can die.
Rat bites and Claw Swipe apply damage and knockback.
Defeat shows a summary and restarts with the same deterministic setup.
controls: Press Enter or R after defeat to restart.
limitations: Unfinished development build with prototype and placeholder presentation.
Eighteen Rats spawn once; there is no timed stream or win condition.
Automatic Claw may defeat every Rat before the House Cat, so the defeat summary and post-defeat restart may not appear in normal play.
XP, progression, choices, and rewards are not implemented.
Verified in desktop Chromium with a keyboard. Other browsers, controllers, and touch input are untested.
